transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what really brought me in is that my mind just won’t stay on one thing anymore. I make jewelry, and lately when I'm at the bench, I just... jump around. I'll go from looking at a customer email to noticing a saw mark on a piece of metal, and then I hear a noise outside. By the time I stop, I realize I’ve completely lost track of the whole work order. It's just getting really hard to get anything done.
How long have you been experiencing these attention and focus problems? Have you always had difficulty concentrating like this, or is this something new that started recently?

No, it's definitely new. I haven't always been like this—I'm usually pretty locked in when I work. But this whole wired, out-of-control stretch... it actually started right after I won an award at a jewelry show. It went on for about two weeks.
During those two weeks after winning the award, did you notice any changes in your mood or energy level—like feeling unusually happy, excited, or energized?

Yeah, I definitely noticed a change. After the show, I just felt... lit up, I guess. Like I was larger than life, totally on top of the world. But then, almost in the same breath, I'd get really irritable. If anyone asked me to stick to normal shop hours or told me to slow down, I just snapped at them. It was like I had all this energy and no patience for anyone trying to put a lid on it.

After those two weeks when you felt 'lit up' and irritable, what happened next? Did your mood and energy level return to normal, or did you experience a significant drop in mood—like feeling depressed, sad, or very low?

It definitely didn't go back to normal. It just... dropped. These past couple weeks, I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the shine has just gone out of everything, you know? I've even... well, I've sat out in my truck and cried before going in to open up the shop. So yeah, I've been feeling really low.
During these past couple of weeks when you've been feeling really low and crying in your truck, have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or ending your life?

Yeah, I have. I just keep having these thoughts that... well, that my family and my clients would be better off if I wasn't around. I don't have a plan or anything to actually do it, but honestly, it scares me how often the thought keeps coming up lately.

Before this stretch two weeks ago when you felt 'lit up' and irritable, have you ever experienced a period like that before—where you felt unusually energized, needed very little sleep, or had racing thoughts and lots of energy for several days or longer?
No, I haven't. That was the first time anything like that has ever happened to me. I've never felt that kind of... extreme energy or been that wired before. It was completely new.

When you were feeling that 'lit up' and irritable energy during those two weeks after the award, were you also able to sleep normally, or did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?

No, my sleep was completely off. For a while, I was only getting maybe two or three hours a night. But the weird thing was, I didn't feel tired at all. I'd wake up completely clear-headed and... just excited, you know? I'd get right out of bed and start cutting stones or posting new designs online way before the sun even came up. It was like I just didn't need sleep.
You mentioned feeling really low these past couple of weeks—has this heavy, hollow feeling and loss of interest been happening every day, or are there days when your mood lifts a bit?

Yeah, it's pretty much every day. These past couple weeks, I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling right from the start. It's like... I don't know, like the shine has just completely gone out of everything. It doesn't really lift at all. It's just there, which is why I've ended up sitting and crying in the truck before I even go in to open the shop.

You said the heavy, hollow feeling started a couple weeks ago after that energetic period ended. Can you be more specific about exactly when it started—was it right after those two weeks of high energy ended, or did some time pass in between?

Well, it didn't really start a couple weeks ago... it's actually been longer than that. The heavy, guilty feeling has been hanging over me for about a month now, I guess. It just sort of settled in right after that really wired period stopped.
When that two-week wired and energetic period ended, did the heavy, hollow feeling start right away—like within a day or two—or was there a gap of time before you started feeling that way?

I'm... I'm not really sure, to be honest. It's hard to remember if there was a gap or not. I just know that wired feeling stopped, and then... well, I was just down in this slump. I don't really know if it was the very next day or if it took a few days to fully set in. It all just kind of blurs together right around the time the energy dropped off.

Let me make sure I have the timeline right: from the day that wired, energetic period ended to right now, how many weeks or days total would you say you've been experiencing this heavy, hollow feeling?

Like I mentioned a minute ago, it's been about a month in total. So from whenever that wired phase stopped up until today... yeah, I'd say roughly four weeks of this depressed feeling just hanging over me.
Before this award at the jewelry show that started everything, have you ever gone through a period—even a shorter one—where you felt depressed, sad, or very low for several days or more?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days here and there, like anyone, but nothing that lasted for days or felt this heavy. This is the first time I've ever felt this low for this long.
